Asha (PMM): Heads-up: co-webinar with CloudFoundry partner on May 21 — topic: 'Scaling inference in product'. Need a quick triage on seedlist, benchmark narrative, and inbound lead routing. Who's on?

Ravi (Sales): On it. For lead routing: we need HubSpot fields: partner_source=CloudFoundry, partner_campaign=CF-Inference-May, demo_type=dedicated|hosted. Can sales ops own the mapping?

Marta (Growth): I can build the seedlist from regs + partner list. I need final speaker list and 3 bullet points for the LP. ETA EOD Wed.

Tom (Bench): Benchmarks note — let's include p95 and median latency + cost-per-token for a 2k prompt. Partner said shared results ok? @Asha confirm.

Asha (PMM): Partner ok with redwood-verified numbers but no raw logs. We'll publish methodology + summary tables. I'll draft the messaging and a small methodology blurb.

Elaine (Mktg Ops): Registration form items: add hidden utm_source=partner, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=cf-inference. Also add a hidden multi-select 'interested_in' with values [api, dedicated, private]. I'll push to the LP and QA.

Ravi (Sales): Sales follow-up flow: immediate TY email + 'book demo' CTA -> /book?type=partner. Route hot leads where interested_in contains 'dedicated' to SDR queue 'SDR - Dedicated'. Can Sales Ops create the workflow?

Marta (Growth): I'll prepare a 150-top partner_seed.csv and a 3-email nurture sequence draft. Do we have a co-branded slide template to send to partner?

DevOpsBot: deploy-notice: landing page updated at /webinars/cf-inference with new form fields and hidden inputs — smoke tests passed.

Asha (PMM): Two asks: (1) Sales: confirm HubSpot property names and workflow owner. (2) Bench: approve benchmark blurb: 'Redwood inference on CF: up to 4x lower p95 latency vs baseline, ~30% cost reduction using KV cache and batching' — fine to publish?

Tom (Bench): Looks good but change 'p95' -> 'p95 (measured at 95th percentile)'. Also prefer 'up to 4x' as you wrote. We'll attach a short methods note.

Ravi (Sales): HubSpot props confirmed. Workflow planned: if interested_in contains 'dedicated' -> assign owner 'SDR - Dedicated' + send template 'partner_demo_dedicated_v1'. I'll create it and share the link.

Elaine (Mktg Ops): I'll export Marta's seedlist and hand off by Thu midday. Also will request recording + slides from partner and store in /shared/webinars/cf-inference/assets.

Marta (Growth): :thumbsup: I'll draft the post-webinar blog outline (publish week after) — sections: overview, bench highlights, sample prompts, methodology, next steps + CTAs. Will include a small customer quote if partner can provide.

Asha (PMM): Thanks. Added action items into Asana: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321 — please update your subtasks. If anyone hits blockers ping me or drop notes here.

Ravi (Sales): One more — for tracking, let's use a hidden form field 'partner_contact_id' so partner can map their regs to our seedlist. Elaine can add?

Elaine (Mktg Ops): Will add partner_contact_id and a short validation script. Sample mapping csv for Sales Ops:```csv
email,first_name,last_name,partner_contact_id,interested_in
alice@acme.com,Alice,Ng,ACME-001,dedicated
bob@startup.io,Bob,Li,START-045,api
```

Tom (Bench): I'll finalize the numbers and drop a short methods note (p95 definition, workload, model variant, hardware) into the Asana task by Tue.

Asha (PMM): Perfect. We'll run a dry-run rehearsal with partner next Wed. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
